critical_code_review_comments: server.py:5082 clamp uses `int(body.reminder_interval_days or 7)` — if user PATCHes reminder_interval_days=0 they get 7 (fallback) instead of 1 (clamp). Minor: 0 is invalid input; negative values still clamp to 1 correctly. Consider `int(body.reminder_interval_days) if body.reminder_interval_days is not None else 7` before max()/min() for consistent clamping semantics.
